faq.title: Your questions before giving it
faq.lead: Still unsure? Write to us, we answer every message.

who.q: If it's a gift, who chooses the photo?
who.a: The person who receives the kit. They enter the code printed in the box and choose their own photo.

skills.q: Do I need to know how to draw?
skills.a: No. You pull the thread from one nail to the next in the order the guide reads out. No artistic skill is needed.

photo.q: Which photo gives the best result?
photo.a: A sharp, front-facing, well-lit photo with a single face. The software frames the face and warns you if the photo is blurry or too dark.

time.a: Several hours, at your own pace. The guide saves your progress, so you pick up where you left off.

privacy.a: It is only used to compute your portrait. It is never published and it is deleted after a limited time.

payment.a: In Algeria, you pay on delivery. Other payment methods depend on your country.

final.title: Give a portrait they'll make themselves
final.text: Everything is in the box, cash on delivery.
